title: Kyndryl earns 21 Brandon Hall Group HCM Excellence Awards® focused on integrity training and skill building
summary: Recognition includes five Gold awards, demonstrating Kyndryl's commitment to integrity, new approaches to learning and building skills
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, October 13, 2026** —[Kyndryl](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en) (NYSE: KD), a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, has earned 21[Brandon Hall Group HCM Excellence Awards®](https://excellenceawards.brandonhall.com/hcm/) , including five Gold awards, recognizing excellence in training employees on ethics and integrity, leadership development, innovative learning programs and employee skill-building.


The Brandon Hall Group Excellence Awards are often referred to as the "Academy Awards of Human Capital Management” and they recognize organizations that demonstrate innovation, measurable business impact and excellence in developing talent.


“This impressive group of awards and recognition from Brandon Hall Group is a testament to Kyndryl’s steadfast commitment to upholding the highest ethical standards and giving our global team the training to build trust through taking the right actions,” said Andrew Bonzani, General Counsel and Secretary at Kyndryl. “Trust is at the heart of our mission-critical support for customers, and as an organization, transparency, accountability and sound judgment are fundamental to how Kyndryls work every day.”


The awards build upon Kyndryl’s broader strategy to prepare its workforce for the future through continuous learning, leadership development and the responsible use of AI. These efforts help Kyndryl develop the expertise needed to support and transform the mission-critical systems that organizations depend on every day.


“At Kyndryl, we believe continuous learning is essential to helping our people grow and our customers succeed,” said Mark Paulek, Chief Human Resources Officer at Kyndryl. “As technology continues to evolve, we’re using AI to create more interactive and personalized learning experiences grounded in real-world and customer scenarios. These programs help Kyndryls build skills, strengthen leadership capabilities and develop the expertise needed to create value for customers and grow their careers. These awards recognize the impact of those investments.”


Among the program’s top honors were seven awards — including two Gold awards — for Kyndryl Code of Conduct 2026: Integrity Decoded, the company’s creative, character-driven employee integrity training. This is the second year in a row that Kyndryl has earned Gold for Best Compliance Training and Best Use of Video for Learning. The engaging training helps Kyndryls understand the importance of acting with integrity, complying with the company’s Code of Conduct and legal requirements, and promptly raising ethical concerns, in an environment that encourages speaking up.


Additional Gold-winning programs recognize the company’s commitment to skill-building and leadership development — and the innovative approach to using AI as a teaching tool. Kyndryl Academy for Consult was recognized with Gold Awards for Best Use of AI for Business Impact and Best Program for Upskilling Employees, and Kyndryl’s course “Engage: Consultative Selling with AI” received a Gold Award for Best Results of a Learning Program.


**About Kyndryl**
Kyndryl (NYSE: KD) is a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, offering advisory, implementation and managed service capabilities to thousands of customers in more than 60 countries. As the world’s largest IT infrastructure services provider, the company designs, builds, manages and modernizes the complex information systems that the world depends on every day. For more information, visit[www.kyndryl.com](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en) .
